title: LangChain chat model from Inferlo's AI
prompt: Part of the team uses LangChain.js. Create src/routes/assistant.ts exporting `assistant`: POST /assistant with body { message } (a string of at most 4000 characters) that answers { answer } (a string). Build the LangChain chat model from the request's Inferlo AI client with Inferlo's LangChain integration, using the "fast" alias and tracking usage for the signed-in user, and call its invoke() with a system message "You are a helpful assistant." and the user's message (LangChain message classes from @langchain/core/messages). Register the route module in src/app.ts.
